sentences.text: Elosuchus possessed an elongated snout similar to a gharial and was likely a fully aquatic animal.
A large skull measuring approximately 1.08 meters long indicates that the animal could reach a body length of up to 7.7 meters.
The type species E. cherifiensis was originally described as a species of Thoracosaurus by Lavocat but was recognized as a separate genus by de Broin in 2002.
De Broin created the family Elosuchidae in 2002 to contain Elosuchus and the genus Stolokrosuchus from Niger.
Elosuchus lived from the Albian to the Cenomanian stages, between 106.3 and 93.9 million years ago.

There is debate regarding Elosuchus's classification, with some analyses placing it in a monophyletic Pholidosauridae and others nesting it with taxa like Sarcosuchus as a sister-taxon to the Dyrosauridae+Pholidosauridae node.
